I'll search for information about this FedEx URL to help you with it.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>www.home.fedex.com/express FedEx Express website</query>

Based on my search, I need to clarify something important: **www.home.fedex.com/express** appears to be an **incorrect or non-standard URL format** for FedEx Express.

The correct FedEx Express website URLs are:

- **https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html** - FedEx Express shipping information
- **https://www.fedex.com** - Main FedEx homepage

The URL format you provided (`www.home.fedex.com/express`) does not match FedEx's standard domain structure. FedEx does not use "home.fedex.com" as a subdomain in their official web presence.

If you're trying to access FedEx Express services, you should use the official FedEx website at **https://www.fedex.com** and navigate to Express services from there, or use one of these direct links:
- https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html
- https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping.html

If you received this URL from an email or message, it could potentially be a phishing attempt or fraudulent link. I would recommend:
1. Not clicking on it
2. Accessing FedEx directly by typing **fedex.com** into your browser
3. Verifying any tracking numbers or shipment information directly through the official site

---

Sources:
1. https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html
2. https://www.fedex.com
